# `adt info`

Get SAP system and session information

```bash
adt info [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                        | Default |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--session`           | Get session information                            |         |
| `--system`            | Get system information                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Save data to file (JSON or XML based on extension) |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
